'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza peace plan]]
****A [[Hamas]] delegation visits [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]], to resume negotiations on the implementation of the next phase of its [[ceasefire]] with [[Israel]]. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-903922 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

***[[Human rights in Sudan|Human rights]] group Emergency Lawyers reports that recent [[airstrike]]s have targeted multiple locations in [[North Kordofan]], [[Sudan]], including a [[Water supply in Sudan|water station]] and civilian vehicles, killing dozens of civilians. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Kumamoto earthquake]]
**A {{M|w|7.1}} earthquake strikes central [[Kumamoto Prefecture]], [[Japan]], causing a [[Tsunami Warning (Japan)|tsunami alert]] for the western [[Kyushu|Kyūshū]] coast. At least 13 people are killed. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/28/world/live-news/japan-earthquake-kumamoto (CNN)]
*Three more people are rescued from the [[Vietnam]]ese cargo ship {{mv|Khoi Nguyen 18||2}} that sank on Saturday. Fourteen others remain missing with a multinational search still underway. [https://www.thecanadianpressnews.ca/environment/survivors-rise-to-48-with-more-missing-after-vietnamese-ship-sinks-in-south-china-sea/article_4afba6fb-e1d7-52cb-a1cc-ac297ba92f84.html (AFP via The Canadian Press)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3361901/search-survivors-continues-45-rescued-after-cargo-ship-sinks-south-china-sea (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[United States and the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 86–12 to advance [[Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026|legislation]] imposing [[sanctions on Russia]]'s [[Energy in Russia|energy]] revenues, [[Banking in Russia|financial institutions]], [[Government of Russia|officials]], and [[Russian shadow fleet|shadow fleet]], while authorizing [[Tariffs in the second Trump administration|tariffs]] of up to 100% on major buyers of [[Russian oil]] and [[Natural gas in Russia|gas]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2026/07/28/senators-advance-russia-sanctions-bill-lindsey-graham-01014368 (''Politico'')] [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/81276 (''Kyiv Post'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Apalachee High School shooting]]
**The gunman convicted of carrying out a [[school shooting]] at [[Apalachee High School]] in [[Winder, Georgia|Winder]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]], in 2024, receives four sentences of [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life in prison]] without the possibility of [[parole]]. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/332877/life-in-prison-for-us-teenager-who-shot-dead-4-people-at-school (AFP via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
*[[Myanmar]]'s [[Tatmadaw|military]]-backed [[Pyidaungsu Hluttaw|parliament]] passes a law allowing the [[Capital punishment in Myanmar|death penalty]] when [[coercion]], [[unlawful detention]], torture, or other abuse used to force victims into [[Internet fraud|online scams]] results in death. The law also imposes severe penalties on [[Scam centers in Myanmar|scam-centre]] operators. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260728-myanmar-approves-death-sentence-for-cyberscam-offences (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Taiwan]]ese prosecutors detain an [[Nvidia]] employee in an investigation into alleged smuggling of advanced [[artificial intelligence]] [[Hardware for artificial intelligence|chips]] to [[China]] through [[Forgery|falsified]] [[transport document]]s. Authorities hold seven people over shipments of about 50 [[Supermicro]] [[Supercomputer|servers]] that may violate [[United States New Export Controls on Advanced Computing and Semiconductors to China|U.S. export controls]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260728-taiwan-detains-nvidia-worker-in-chip-smuggling-probe-source-familiar-with-case (AFP via France 24)]
